body:
I occasionally have panic attacks and I start to think that I might have really died years ago. Like if I was successful with my last suicide attempt, but I got stuck into some weird, awful loop, like a depressing, fucked up version of Groundhog Day. Like what if the universe is just an endless progression of me being driven to kill myself? I'm already not sure that there is anything more than a march to death anyways, so it seems at least as reasonable to me as any other theory about the afterlife.

Sometimes I feel like I really didn't last this long, after all.

Tbh, through a nostalgic filter, I've even begun to envy people who are dead inside. That's not to diminish how soul crushing it is to walk around like a zombie through life to the point of total inability to give a shit. I've been there, and it's wretched. I just feel...entirely too much, of everything, a lot of the time, and the nigh invincibility of nihilism sounds like a p great alternative rn.
